extName.message: Urna Guard – voting-machine alerts on X

extDescription.message: Flags (never hides) posts on X with signs of disinformation about Brazil's electronic voting machine and suspicious accounts. 100% local.

badgeAria.message: Urna Guard: see why this post was flagged

panelTitleYellow.message: Caution: this post repeats common misinformation claims about voting machines.

panelTitleRed.message: High risk: misinformation claims from an account showing signs of automation or coordination.

whatToDo.message: What to do: check an official source before sharing.

notDisinfoTitle.message: Saves your feedback in this browser only, lowers these signals' weight and adds the author to your trusted list

disclaimer.message: Automatic heuristic, not proof. False positives can happen. Do not use it to harass anyone. Nothing was hidden or reported.

popOnHint.message: Badges show up on X posts.

sensCustom.message: Customized in options. Pick a level to go back to a preset.

popDisc.message: Heuristics, not proof. Never hides or reports posts. Data stays in this browser only (LGPD).

ob1.message: When an X post shows signs of misinformation about voting machines, a badge appears next to the author's name. No post is ever hidden.

ob1y.message: Yellow: the text repeats common misinformation claims.

ob1r.message: Red: on top of that, the account looks automated or coordinated.

ob2.message: One click on the badge explains the alert in plain language, with official links to check. If we got it wrong, click “Not misinformation”.

ob3.message: You can change this anytime from the Urna Guard icon in the browser toolbar.

obPrivacy.message: Everything stays in this browser: no servers, no accounts, no tracking (LGPD). Heuristics are not proof; do not use them to harass anyone.
